claims.evidence: Durability cannot be assessed from a static photo
Photo 0 shows visible wear and dirt on the frame
No purchase date, receipt, or timestamp visible in the photo
Report notes functionality of gear shifting and braking performance is not shown
Report notes rust/dents not visible in this angle; only front portion is shown
No brand/model legible, no way to confirm part originality from a photo

risks.risk: Rear wheel, chain, and drivetrain condition unknown
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full drivetrain (rear derailleur, chain, cassette) from the side

risks.risk: Hidden rust or corrosion on frame or rear parts
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, rear stays, and underside of the bike
Short video clip of gears shifting through range and brakes engaging while wheel spins

risks.risk: Tire tread wear and tube condition on rear tire
risks.proof: Close-up photo of rear tire tread and a photo showing tube inflated without patches
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn tires needing replacement

risks.risk: Seat, pedals, and cable condition not detailed
risks.proof: Full side-profile photo showing seat, pedals, and cable housing

risks.risk: Age/maintenance history cannot be confirmed from image alone
risks.proof: Original receipt or purchase photo with date
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, treated as used/worn

proof_requests: Full side-profile photo of the entire bicycle
Close-up of rear wheel, chain, and derailleur
Close-up of frame joints and underside for rust check
Video of gears shifting and brakes engaging
Close-up of rear tire tread and tube
Photo of seat, pedals, and cable housing
Photo of purchase receipt or box if available
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a bicycle, so it can be priced at worst case given visible wear and multiple unverified seller claims about condition, age, and originality.
